notes: Profile: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app assistant). High-touch product team; engineering-led buy. Decision-makers: CTO (Maya Lin), Head of Product (Jonah Reed), VP Ops (Kira Singh)
Use-case detail: in-app assistant (primary) + semantic doc search for support docs; reranking pipeline for help articles. Embeddings store expected ~200M vectors after year 1
Latency/Throughput targets: goal p95 < 200ms for chat completion on product-assist; 5k req/day steady, spikes to 25k/day during release windows; embeddings batch inserts overnight

Cost sensitivity: mid-high. Wants to cap hosted spend while testing — exploring Dedicated commit to lower unit costs. Target ARR band in estimate drives desire for a predictable monthly committed spend
Model preferences: experimenting with open LLMs (mix of 13B quantized + 70B for high-quality reranks). Wants model-variant routing: light/fast for low-latency UI, high-quality for long-form summaries
Security/Compliance: must support SSO/SAML, KMS-integrated key management for embeddings, audit logs for model calls, and EU data residency for EU customer data — legal flagged residency as blocker
POC ask (high level): 2-week Dedicated POC with canary routing. Objectives: validate latency SLOs, measure unit costs at scale, verify VPC connectivity and KMS integration

POC details (engineer notes): 
- Canary plan: start 10% traffic to Dedicated pool, monitor errors/latency (48h), ramp 10%→30%→60%→100% over ~7 days if stable.
- Fallback routing: automatic fallback to hosted_api model-variant (quantized smaller model) on errors or when Dedicated saturates.
- Model variants: production pin to 13B-quant-q4 for UI fast path; stable 70B-16k for rerank/long generation. Canary will run 13B-quant then cross-compare outputs to hosted 70B rerank for quality checks.
- Region failover: primary us-east-1 Dedicated pool; eu-west-1 mirror (replicated KV cache). Failover policy: latency-first for EU users, region-based routing with automatic failover on region health and capacity.
- Rollback: traffic-shift tool available, manual rollback triggers in console + automatic rollback if error-rate > 3% sustained for 10m.
- Warmers: prefill KV cache with frequent prefixes (product-train prompts).
Quote from CTO (Maya): "We need predictable unit economics before committing to Dedicated — but can't accept >250ms p95 on critical product flows."

Commercial: asked for Dedicated pricing with a 6/12-month commit option + overage terms. AE provided preliminary range (see drive pricing doc). Procurement wants a starter "pilot" commit with convertible credits
Technical risks called out: VPC peering rules, egress policies, KMS integration window, embedding residency enforcement. Network team needs specific port/IP list (AE to provide infra guide).
Decision cadence: security + product sign-off by mid-March; finance to sign contract by April if POC meets SLO and cost model

Internal notes (AE): plan to deliver canary playbook, SLO dashboard template, and a short eval script to compare generation quality between variants. Follow-up: schedule kickoff with infra + security (requested 72h lead time)
